pairs.description: Pairs of doodle cards in the heap. Setting it replaces the built-in progression (5, 10, 15 ... 40 pairs over 8 levels) for the level in play and every later level: pairs are dealt into the heap or taken out of it immediately. More pairs mean a bigger heap to search.

clusterSpread.description: Size of the heap the cards are scattered in, as a multiple of the game's own (which grows with the number of cards). Lower values pack the cards tighter so more of them overlap and hide each other; higher values spread them out. Applies to the heap in play immediately.

cardRotation.description: Largest tilt of a card in the heap, in degrees. 0 = every card upright, 180 = any orientation (the game's default). Applies to the heap in play immediately; cards the player drags still spin a little.
